notes.title: v0.3 Farm Planting System
notes.content:
New contentBrand new Farm  planting system
You can build planters to plant various vegetables. including: tomatoes, watermelons, potatoes, corn, carrots, cucumbers， Weather changes, sunlight and moonlight will affect plant growth, water and fertilize, and maintain crops. More crops and even fruit trees will be updated in the future

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743241/bc3bdc96233c96a9f35d15a5a5b1893afb9bcd0d.png"]

How to plant?

First, you need to buy crop seeds from the NPC indigenous trader, Craft a Farm plan through the player-made list, hold it with the right mouse button to open the circular menu and select the planter to place on the ground, then select the seeds and place them on the planter.

Craft a watering can, Right click on the plant to open the menu. First, you need to collect water, make pesticides and fertilizers, and irrigate, spray pesticides, remove and fertilize.

Some tips: Crops will be automatically irrigated in rainy weather. Crop will stop growing when Plant health value is less than 50%, so spray with pesticides in time.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743241/0ae3c835a00f275e75d0f8ae8f3706f3569363d2.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743241/c5d4cfbd5e44a32c1617f450b03dda35a9d48187.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743241/829c5badcbcb58bef85adf8813a7fe221f9ded1c.png"]
